content.body: The British Army used the Bedford OY throughout the war, in all theaters. By V-E Day, the British Army alone had more than 390,000 Bedfords (or similar) in service. The 3-ton truck was the standard transport for the British Army.
content.brief: TYPE: 3 Ton Truck TOWING CAPACITY: Medium LOAD: 3,813 kg WEIGHT: 2,694 kg SPEED (road): 70 km/h
